turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of a class?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. Your own procedure, 4.2, says the call comes first, so that much is settled. Now, on what basis did you enter it?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.

I'm writing that down: zero withdrawn today, nothing on his record, email tonight. What I don't have is a reason for a rewrite at all, so if the zero comes off, what's wrong with the essay he already handed in?
Here it is in writing, signed.
Hand it over; I'll read every line before I agree to anything. While I do, tell me who else has seen that zero, and whether anything is sitting on his record right now.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
I'm not done, Hale. Who has seen that zero and what is on his record right now are both still unanswered, and so is the reason for a rewrite.
Then I'm going to the principal's office from here, with your signed page in my hand. Answer those two questions and I'll walk out to my car instead.
